sections.When to use this: You are changing the root `README.md`, the package page nuget.org renders, or a page of the documentation site. The reader has installed nothing and has nobody here to ask, and that is the whole difference from every other surface.
sections.Prerequisites:
* `technical-writing` and `writing-the-docs`, loaded in that order.
* The source for every fact the page states, so each one can be checked.
* The .NET SDK, where you touched the package page.
